items.question: Are there contract jobs for BAMS doctors under the National AYUSH Mission?

row.judgeReason: The response accurately addresses the question using verified guidelines, clearly distinguishes UG/PG roles under NAM, avoids medical advice, and acknowledges limitations regarding state-level contract details.

raw.answer: Under the National AYUSH Mission Operational Guidelines, there are specific manpower roles defined for AYUSH doctors across different public health levels [c:c9a29c07d06bcb2afd6a3fb632d3bc394b9a5d40][c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543]. At Community Health Centres (CHCs), the guidelines specify a role for an AYUSH doctor with a UG qualification, while District Hospitals (DH) have a role for an AYUSH doctor with a PG qualification [c:c9a29c07d06bcb2afd6a3fb632d3bc394b9a5d40][c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543]. Also, mobile health teams work at Primary Health Centres (PHCs) [c:c9a29c07d06bcb2afd6a3fb632d3bc394b9a5d40]. In a CHC role with a UG qualification, your responsibilities include opportunistic screening, health promotion, managing identified conditions, treating NCD complications with AYUSH medicine as an adjuvant, and overall supervision of the NCD Unit [c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543]. You also monitor the functioning of the Lifestyle Clinic, compile data from CHCs and PHCs, and guide the Yoga professional [c:334a2ce05515b2eb004a56d941d3f125734df543]. Separate from NAM, the Ministry of Ayush also engages Young Professionals and Consultants (retired Government Servants, including retired doctors) under specific contract guidelines [c:78d0e7e69132dcf479bcfa706a99380ab9f1e28f][c:53f20946956cf31b76b4554a1c7cac0a83939e8c]. However, the sources available to me don't cover the specific contractual nature, salary, or state-level recruitment notifications for UG AYUSH doctors under NAM yet — a mentor will confirm. Since recruitment rules and schemes change every year, always verify the exact terms on your state AYUSH department or commission website before applying.
actions: Read the National AYUSH Mission Operational Guidelines to understand the clinical and administrative duties of a UG AYUSH doctor at a CHC.
Complete your internship and keep your state board registration documents ready for upcoming state notifications.
Check your state AYUSH society and official state recruitment portals regularly for fresh vacancy notifications.
raw.mistake: Confusing central Ministry of Ayush consultant advertisements or PG-level District Hospital posts with UG-level Community Health Centre roles without reading the exact qualification criteria in the notification.
